title: No analytics for v2
body:
When looking into Google Analytics, I can't find any of them for the v2.
But I can see them for the v1.

Usage for `googleTagManager` might be missing. (see: https://github.com/algolia/react-instantsearch/blob/fbbe9386e79acd4c36f03b54580321910b7a27a2/docgen/layouts/common/marketing.pug)
